about: Demon Attack (Atari 2600) for the C64: builder profile. Contains no original game code: every copy of the ROM's bytes is blanked, and the user's ROM supplies them.
title: Demon Attack
controls: Move, fire (or a joystick in port 2; player 2 in a two-player game: port 1)
Power off and on (back to game 1, no score)
Left / right difficulty (A: the demons attack more aggressively)
